Whakakatakata i taku GPS UnifiedNlp Ratonga Wāhi
Te whakaaetanga taumata hainatanga, e hiahiatia ana mō te Mock my GPS kia tuku whakahou mō ngā wāhi ki tōna UnifiedNlp Wāhanga o muri.
Ngā whakamahinga "Whakakatakata i taku GPS" hei kaiwhakarato wāhi papamuri i te wā e kaha ana tana ratonga.

Te maha o ngā milisekona kua tāpirihia ki te tohu wā o ngā whakahōutanga tūnga katoa. Mā tētahi uara nui e whakarite kia kore e aro atu ki ērā atu kaiwhakarato papamuri i te wā e whakahohe ana te whakamātau ā-tārua.:
